question: Where is café situated within 130 kilometers along the travel path toward Park Hyatt New York, New York, NY from Art Clinic, New York, NY?
sql:
WITH
    angle AS (SELECT degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.979314 40.765422)',4326)::geography)) AS value)
SELECT * FROM pois,angle
WHERE amenity = 'cafe'
AND ST_DWithin(pois.geometry, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography, 130000)
AND (degrees(ST_Azimuth(ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.983174 40.718763)',4326)::geography, pois.geometry)) BETWEEN angle.value - 22.5 AND angle.value + 22.5);
